Attention backend

sage fp8 cuda++ is the fastest path on a recent NVIDIA card, but it
needs Sage Attention installed. If the console says it is missing,
switch this to 'auto' -- the graph runs either way.

No negative prompt on H3

H3 runs at CFG 1: the sampler reads the positive only, a negative
has nothing to push against.

NAG cannot help either. It guides inside a CROSS-attention, and H3
has none -- text, video and audio run as one joint sequence. The
Polyhedron NAG node refuses H3 and says so in the console, so this
template has no NAG node.

To keep something out of the picture, describe what you DO want.

1: Minimax_h3_ref3va: for Image to Video
2: Minimax_h3_fl2va: for Text to Video
                                        
                                   ↓

Minimax_h3_ref3va: Use Input Pictures
Minimax_h3_fl2va: Bypass group!

Minimax_h3_ref2v: for Image to Video (4 steps)
Minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo: for Text to Video (8 steps // 4 steps)

🛈 I use all of it simultaneously with 8 Steps. Seems to be ok. :)

nodes.title: THE TIMELINE -- how this template runs
widgets_values:
THE CINE TIMELINE -- how this template runs

- The timeline holds the film: three shots in 5.875 s (141 frames).
  The fixed parts of the prompt live in the CLIP Text Encode:
  segment 1 = triggers, look, scene, light; segment 2 = subject, mood.
  The timeline carries {pos_1} and {pos_2} where they belong, plus the
  camera and the motion of each shot (CLIP Text Encode: external_mode =
  fill {pos_N}). 'prompt the run will produce' shows the exact text.

- Queue: the clip of the INTERP Save (wired to clip_prefix) lands on
  V1, picture and sound, in today's folder:
  output/<date>/PH_<time>_fox_whole_*.mp4

- Queue again (another seed, another shot text): with 'new render ->
  new track' on, the new clip becomes a track on top, as tall as V1;
  V1 keeps its clip. Cut, heal, delete, change the speed of a piece,
  unlink picture and sound (the bracket at the left), then export the
  film from the tracks.

- The LoRA Stack ships EMPTY -- add your own. The example film was
  rendered exactly like this (assets/fox_h3_run.mp4). gold8en and fo8g
  in segment 1 are the trigger words of two scene LoRAs; without
  those LoRAs they are plain words, kept so the run reproduces.
